items.title: How climate change and food insecurity could fuel future conflicts
items.description: Climate change, conflict, and trade tensions are putting pressure on the global food system. New research suggests the biggest risk is not food shortages, but whether societies can peacefully adapt to change.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
items.description: Germany's AfD has hailed a "historic result" and is projected to win 44% of the vote, far ahead of the conservatives on 17%.

items.title: Austria's Islamic headscarf ban in force as under-14s go back to school
items.description: The government says the law is intended to protect the rights of young girls, but critics say it is fuelling anti-Muslim feeling.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD celebrate projected win in state election
items.description: AfD leaders celebrated tonight as exit polls projected a big lead in the Saxony-Anhalt vote.

items.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Far-right AfD secures huge lead in key vote
items.description: The far-right AfD has taken a massive lead at the Saxony-Anhalt election, although it was not clear if it will be able to form government. The party's state leader said the result sends "a signal to Berlin." Follow DW.
